svg.title: Compare Contracted Fee Yield, Not Client Deal Size
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-qualified-opportunity-fee-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Contracted Fee Yield, Not Client Deal Size; subtitle: Five illustrative enterprise sub-niches priced per accepted opportunity.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are illustrative USD operator fees per accepted opportunity, excluding retainers and before delivery expense. They are neither market quotations nor profit estimates. The five bars are alternative pricing hypotheses, not a portfolio mix to be added together. The Base illustration uses only the $1,500 fee assumption. ACH and wire describe collection methods, not permission to pay referral fees.; caption: Test fee yield against delivery cost, acceptance rate, collection delay, and dispute frequency before choosing a sub-niche.; stages: label: Workforce software; value: $900 per accepted enterprise workforce-software opportunity.; numeric value: 900.0; detail: Illustrative ACH collection against a verified acceptance record. Qualify organization size, operating footprint, buying role, and a defined workforce-platform initiative.; label: Logistics software; value: $1,200 per accepted enterprise logistics-software opportunity.; numeric value: 1200.0; detail: Illustrative ACH collection for software demand generation, not freight brokerage. Qualify shipment scale, integration requirements, operations ownership, and an active evaluation.; label: Industrial software; value: $1,500 per accepted enterprise industrial-software opportunity.; numeric value: 1500.0; detail: Base fee assumption: 90 accepted opportunities generate $135,000. Qualify facility context, technical owner, integration constraints, and a documented evaluation step.; label: Cybersecurity platforms; value: $1,800 per accepted enterprise cybersecurity-platform opportunity.; numeric value: 1800.0; detail: Illustrative wire collection after documented acceptance. Qualify security ownership, deployment context, procurement path, and relevant need without collecting sensitive system access details.; label: Enterprise data platforms; value: $2,100 per accepted enterprise data-platform opportunity.; numeric value: 2100.0; detail: Illustrative wire collection against a fixed-fee invoice. Qualify architecture fit, data-platform ownership, migration trigger, and a credible next evaluation step; exclude any percentage of the client's contract value.

text.title: Compare Contracted Fee Yield, Not Client Deal Size
text.tspan: Compare Contracted Fee Yield, Not Client Deal Size

circle.title: label: Workforce software; value: $900 per accepted enterprise workforce-software opportunity.; numeric value: 900.0; detail: Illustrative ACH collection against a verified acceptance record. Qualify organization size, operating footprint, buying role, and a defined workforce-platform initiative.

label: Logistics software; value: $1,200 per accepted enterprise logistics-software opportunity.; numeric value: 1200.0; detail: Illustrative ACH collection for software demand generation, not freight brokerage. Qualify shipment scale, integration requirements, operations ownership, and an active evaluation.

label: Industrial software; value: $1,500 per accepted enterprise industrial-software opportunity.; numeric value: 1500.0; detail: Base fee assumption: 90 accepted opportunities generate $135,000. Qualify facility context, technical owner, integration constraints, and a documented evaluation step.

label: Cybersecurity platforms; value: $1,800 per accepted enterprise cybersecurity-platform opportunity.; numeric value: 1800.0; detail: Illustrative wire collection after documented acceptance. Qualify security ownership, deployment context, procurement path, and relevant need without collecting sensitive system access details.

label: Enterprise data platforms; value: $2,100 per accepted enterprise data-platform opportunity.; numeric value: 2100.0; detail: Illustrative wire collection against a fixed-fee invoice. Qualify architecture fit, data-platform ownership, migration trigger, and a credible next evaluation step; exclude any percentage of the client's contract value.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are illustrative USD operator fees per accepted opportunity, excluding retainers and before delivery expense. They are neither market quotations nor profit estimates. The five bars are alternative pricing hypotheses, not a portfolio mix to be added together. The Base illustration uses only the $1,500 fee assumption. ACH and wire describe collection methods, not permission to pay referral fees.
